description: The link to connect the client’s Shopify store to Rabbit, without leaving the conversation: they open it, check their store and account, then accept on Shopify. Single use, ten minutes. With no known address, the tool says to ask them for it. Returns nothing if the store is not open to their account, or if it is already connected. Call it as soon as their store isn’t connected and they need it: never tell them to connect it without this link.

boutique.description: Their store address in .myshopify.com, or its name (“my-store”), if the client said it.

name: connect_my_store
title: Connect my store
